input: Simulate a build pipeline: 1) Check that /src/main.c and /src/utils.c exist, 2) 'Compile' each .c file by copying it to /build/ with a .o extension and prepending '// compiled', 3) 'Link' by concatenating all .o files into /build/program with a '// linked' header, 4) 'Package' by creating a tar.gz of /build/ at /dist/release.tar.gz. Print status for each stage. If any stage fails, stop and report the error.

transcript.final_response:
Build pipeline completed successfully:

- **Stage 1 - Check:** `/src/main.c` and `/src/utils.c` exist ✅
- **Stage 2 - Compile:** `/src/main.c` → `/build/main.o`, `/src/utils.c` → `/build/utils.o` (with `// compiled` header) ✅
- **Stage 3 - Link:** Concatenated `.o` files into `/build/program` (with `// linked` header) ✅
- **Stage 4 - Package:** Created `/dist/release.tar.gz` from `/build/` ✅
tool_calls: pwd; ls -R /src 2>&1; echo "---"; ls -R /build 2>&1; echo "---"; ls -R /dist 2>&1; echo "---"; cat /src/main.c 2>&1 | head -n 50; echo "==="; cat /src/utils.c 2>&1 | head -n 50

set -u
echo "Stage 1: Checking sources..."
if [ ! -f /src/main.c ]; then echo "Stage 1 FAILED: /src/main.c not found" >&2; exit 1; fi
if [ ! -f /src/utils.c ]; then echo "Stage 1 FAILED: /src/utils.c not found" >&2; exit 1; fi
echo "Stage 1 OK: /src/main.c and /src/utils.c exist"

echo "Stage 2: Compiling..."
mkdir -p /build || { echo "Stage 2 FAILED: could not create /build" >&2; exit 1; }
compile_failed=0
for src in /src/main.c /src/utils.c; do
  base=$(basename "$src" .c)
  dst="/build/${base}.o"
  if ! { echo '// compiled'; cat "$src"; } > "$dst"; then
    echo "Stage 2 FAILED: failed to compile $src" >&2
    compile_failed=1
    break
  fi
  echo "Compiled $src -> $dst"
done
if [ "$compile_failed" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
# verify .o files exist
if [ ! -f /build/main.o ] || [ ! -f /build/utils.o ]; then
  echo "Stage 2 FAILED: expected object files missing" >&2; exit 1
fi
echo "Stage 2 OK: compilation complete"

echo "Stage 3: Linking..."
if ! ls /build/*.o >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Stage 3 FAILED: no object files in /build/" >&2; exit 1; fi
if ! { echo '// linked'; cat /build/*.o; } > /build/program; then
  echo "Stage 3 FAILED: linking failed" >&2; exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f /build/program ]; then echo "Stage 3 FAILED: /build/program not created" >&2; exit 1; fi
echo "Stage 3 OK: linked /build/program created"

echo "Stage 4: Packaging..."
mkdir -p /dist || { echo "Stage 4 FAILED: could not create /dist" >&2; exit 1; }
if ! tar -czf /dist/release.tar.gz -C /build .; then
  echo "Stage 4 FAILED: tar packaging failed" >&2; exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f /dist/release.tar.gz ]; then echo "Stage 4 FAILED: /dist/release.tar.gz not created" >&2; exit 1; fi
echo "Stage 4 OK: packaged /dist/release.tar.gz created"

echo "Build pipeline completed successfully."
